title: Adventure with Types in Haskell - Simon Peyton Jones (Lecture 1)
summary: Simon Peyton Jones's first lecture on types in Haskell from the Oregon Programming Languages Summer School 2013. It covers type classes and how they relate to OOP, subtyping and polymorphism.
why: Mostly cited by timestamp for specific explanations, such as how type classes map to OOP and why QuickCheck is a great type class example.

quote.text: it's the coolest example of type classes Simon Peyton Jones knows and he explains why here (around 34-35 min)
